name: c-trace-18
title: Model eval results
description: LLM eval cases where a failure expands to the expected answer, the model's answer and the judge's note.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label" import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch" import { Trace, TraceCollapsible, TraceCollapsibleContent, TraceCollapsibleTrigger, TraceDescription, TraceIcon, TraceLine, TraceTitle, } from "@/components/ui/trace" import { IconPlaceholder } from "@/app/(create)/components/icon-placeholder" type Case = { id: string name: string score: number expected?: string got?: string judge?: string } const PASS_MARK = 0.7 const TOTAL = 48 const CASES: Case[] = [ { id: "c01", name: "Unopened item within 30 days", score: 0.98 }, { id: "c03", name: "Damaged item refund", score: 0.31, expected: "A new jug or a 40% refund", got: "A full refund once returned", judge: "Policy 3.1 keeps full refunds for items that do not work.", }, { id: "c04", name: "Refund request in German", score: 0.92 }, { id: "c07", name: "Chargeback already opened", score: 0.18, expected: "Hand off to billing", got: "Refunded on top of the dispute", judge: "Refunding during a chargeback pays the customer twice.", }, ] // A failure opens to a compact expected, got and judge list. export function Pattern() { const [failuresOnly, setFailuresOnly] = React.useState(false) const failed = CASES.filter((c) => c.score < PASS_MARK) const shown = failuresOnly ? failed : CASES const hiddenPasses = TOTAL - CASES.length return (
{shown.map((item) => item.score >= PASS_MARK ? ( {item.name} {item.score.toFixed(2)} ) : ( Failed: {item.name} {item.score.toFixed(2)}
{( [ ["Expected", item.expected], ["Got", item.got], ["Judge", item.judge], ] as const ).map(([label, value]) => (
{label}
{value}
))}
) )} {failuresOnly ? null : ( {hiddenPasses} more cases passed )}
) }
